searchText: The feature we really need from Discord that they are not working on is to make it so community servers disable DMs between members by default, rather than enabled by default and allowing individual users to override that setting to off.

excerpts.content: The feature we really need from Discord that they are not working on is to make it so community servers disable DMs between members by default, rather than enabled by default and allowing individual users to override that setting to off.
